instruction: A candid, warm-toned photographic portrait in a medium shot captures a festive nighttime setting decorated with hanging warm string lights. On the left, the man in the white shirt with pink lip prints (R2) stands facing forward, holding a bouquet of red and white roses with both hands while looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. Beside him on the right, the woman in the striped tank top (R1) stands slightly behind, smiling warmly at the camera as she loops her arm through his. The background is softly blurred, emphasizing the couple. Warm, soft lighting from the overhead fairy lights illuminates them, casting a cozy and romantic glow over the entire scene.
elements: R1 loops her arm through R2's arm while standing slightly behind him
R2 holds a bouquet with both hands while R1 links arms with him
R1 smiles warmly at the camera while linked to R2
R2 faces forward and looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression
R2 holds a bouquet of red and white roses
festive nighttime setting with hanging warm string lights
